title: "Route" left label (weaker)
description: Left header label changes from "Destino" to "Ruta" ("route"). Weaker option: the rows underneath show headsigns (specific destination/via text per departure, including a circular route), not route identifiers or numbers, so "Ruta" is a less accurate description of the column's content than "Destino". Included for completeness, not recommended. Right label ("Próxima salida") is unchanged.

changes.intent: Explore an alternative left-column label; flagged as less accurate since the column holds headsigns, not route identifiers.
changes.detail: Change the static text of the first header span from "Destino" to "Ruta". No structural or style change. Weaker than baseline — recommend keeping "Destino" or using label-hacia instead.
